judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete, stopping partway through its own Definition of Done. Crucially, `ToolRegistry.execute` was never updated to call `validateInput`, meaning the core requirement of validating tool inputs at execution time is completely absent and three of the four tests in the newly added `registry.acceptance.test.ts` will fail. Additionally, dynamic `ToolDefinitionSource` functions are wrongly compiled at registration time instead of per-call with a `WeakMap` cache. Finally, most of the required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the JSDoc comment on `execute`, and the documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts` are missing.
